title: Verify Parts Manager can delete a parts return
preconds:
Log in to ShopView as a user assigned the Parts Manager role. (deleting a return requires Invoicing & Payments: Delete per spec v33 / SV-7911; this role has it).
At least one parts return record exists under Parts > Returns.
steps:
1. Click Parts, open Returns, and open a return record.
2. Click Delete and confirm.
expected: The return is deleted and removed from the Returns list.
